lines.say: One Israeli soldier. How many prisoners did Israel free to bring him home?
Start with October twenty twenty five.
Twenty living hostages came home from Gaza.
Israel freed one thousand nine hundred and sixty eight prisoners.
About ninety eight for every living hostage.
Earlier that year, the deal set a price in advance.
Thirty prisoners for each civilian. Fifty for each soldier.
Now go back to twenty eleven. One soldier: Gilad Shalit.
To bring him home, Israel freed one thousand and twenty seven prisoners.
The most senior of them was Yahya Sinwar.
Twelve years later, he was the mastermind of October seventh.
Many of those freed in twenty twenty five were detained during the war, not convicted.
So when people ask what one Israeli life is worth, start with this:

end.balance: Bringing people home is *right.* Ask who got out.

caption_en:
One soldier. 1,027 prisoners. 🕊️

Oct 2025: 20 living hostages came home; Israel released 1,968 Palestinian prisoners and detainees (1,718 of them detained during the Gaza war, 250 serving life or long sentences). About 98 per living hostage.
Jan to Mar 2025: the deal set the ratio in advance: 30 prisoners per civilian, 50 per soldier. 1,778 released in total.
2011: Israel released 1,027 prisoners for one soldier, Gilad Shalit. Al Jazeera called Yahya Sinwar the most senior of them. Twelve years later he was the mastermind of the October 7 attack.

Many of those freed in 2025 had been detained during the war, not convicted. Bringing people home is right. It's worth asking who walked out.

Send this to someone who asks what one Israeli life is worth.
caption_he:
חייל אחד. 1,027 אסירים.
אוקטובר 2025: 20 חטופים חיים חזרו, וישראל שחררה 1,968 אסירים ועצורים (1,718 מהם נעצרו במלחמה, 250 עם מאסרי עולם או ארוכים). בערך 98 לכל חטוף חי.
ינואר עד מרץ 2025: היחס נקבע מראש, 30 אסירים לכל אזרח ו-50 לכל חיילת.
2011: ישראל שחררה 1,027 אסירים תמורת גלעד שליט. הבכיר שבהם היה יחיא סינוואר. 12 שנה אחר כך הוא תכנן את 7 באוקטובר.
רבים מהמשוחררים ב-2025 נעצרו במלחמה ולא הורשעו. להחזיר אנשים הביתה זה נכון. כדאי לשאול מי יצא.

Sources: Asharq Al-Awsat, tally of prisoner swaps after two years of war (2025); Al Jazeera, "Profiles: The prisoners behind the swap" (2011); Al Majalla, "Yahya Sinwar: HAMAS leader and October 7 mastermind" (2023).
